'''February 2001 New York City Reflections II Booster Draft tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft held in Neutral Ground, New York City, New York on 10 February 2001. [[Aaron Kingery]] and [[Marco Habert]] won it. It is known from Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1726">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-2-10-nyc-sealed-search-for-r2-sheetd1726/ 2-10-nyc-sealed-search-for-r2-sheet], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-2-10-nyc-sealed-search-for-r2-sheetd1726/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[February 2001 New York City tournament]].

* '''Date:''' 10 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Neutral Ground, New York City, New York
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Aaron Kingery]] and [[Marco Habert]]
